content: Okuyirhwa kwa Yakobo n'ogushwekwa kwa Petero
Mw'amo mango, mwami Heroode arhondera kulibuza bantu baguma b'echigusho ch'abemeezi.
Anayirha Yakobo mwene waabo Yohaana n'engoorho.
Abeere abona okw'ebyo byasimiisize aBayaahudi, aderha oku bafarhe Petero naye. Ebyoola byajirikaga amango m'edinye y'emigati nzira chachu.

Abeere amafarha Petero n'okumuhira omu munyororo, amuhira omu bulanzi bw'ebigusho bine by'abasoda baneebane eyi bali guhinguulirana. Ajira ntyo ey'ali gukengeera okw'amuburaniisa embere w'olubaga enyuma w'ePaasaka.
Oku Petero alangirwe omu munyororo, echigusho ch'abemeezi boowe baliiri bakomeza kumusaliirira bweneene emwa Nnamahanga.
Malahika wa Nnaweerhu akuula Petero omu munyororo
Obudufu b'olo lusiku Heroode akaburanyize Petero, Petero alilyaamire ahagarhi k'abasoda babiri ey'anashwekerwe n'amalegule mabiri. N'abalanzi baliiri embere z'omulyango eyi bali balanga omunyororo.

Ho n'aho malahika wa Nnaweerhu ahulukira n'obumoleke bwayunjula omu busiika b'ogo munyororo. Malahika abanda ku Petero omu mbavu, amuchula n'okumubwira ntya: «Yimanga juba!» Amalegule malishwekere amaboko maage machishwekuula, marhogera ahashi.
Malahika ava amubwira ntya: «Yambala omukaba gwawe n'ebiraato byaawe.» Naye ajira ntyo. Kandi, malahika amubwira ntya: «Yambala egorhe lyawe, onankulikire.»
Petero ahuluka eyi anamukulikiire, aliko arhamenyaga kw'echijiro cha malahika chiri ch'okuli: alikengereere okw'abonekeerwe.

Babeere bamarhaluka echigusho girhanzi ch'abalanzi n'echakabiri, baahika oku mulyango gw'echuuma guyerekeere omu gishagala. Ogo mulyango gwachichinguula gonyine embere zaabo. Nabo bahuluka n'ogukomeza kugenda omu njira. Ho n'aho oyo malahika amuleka.

Petero abeere arhegeera okw'ebyabeere biri by'okuli, ava aderha ntya: «Bunoola namaaja naamenya oku Nnaweerhu arhumaga malahika waage, anankuulire omu maboko ma Heroode n'omu mabi mooshi aBayaahudi balilangaliire okw'ankolera.»
Petero abeere amenya bwinja ebyabeere, agenda emwa Mariya, nyina wa Yohaana. Oyo Yohaana ye washembulwaga Mariko. Omu mwage mu bantu banene balichigushire n'ogusaliira Nnamahanga.
Petero abeere akongoorha oku lunvi lw'embuga, omukozi muguma w'omunyere oyirikwa Rooda ayegeera omulyango kubaza nde oli akongoorha.
Arhegeera omulenge gwa Petero, aliko ahaali h'okumuchinguulira, alibirha n'obushaguluke kuja kubwira abaabo oku Petero ali oku mulyango gw'embuga.
Nabo bamubwira ntya: «Ego munyere! Wasirehere!» Aliko Rooda agendekera kuderha ntya: «Neechi, yeewe maani!» Boowe baliiri bakomeza kuderha ntya: «Oyoola, ali malahika waage.»
Aliko Petero agendekera gukongoorha oku lunvi. Baava bachinguula, banasoomerwa bweneene kumubona.
Abasimira n'okuboko mpu basire. Ababalira gurhe Nnaweerhu amukuulire omu munyororo n'okubabwira ntya: «Mubibalire Yakobo
na beene beerhu.» Petero ava ahuluka n'okuja ahandi hantu.
Bwacheere eseezi, abasoda bagwarha obuuba bunene n'okubazana ntya: «Bichi byahikiire Petero?»

Heroode arhuma abantu mpu bamushonde, aliko barhamubonaga. Asambiisa abalanzi, anarhegeka oku bayirhwe. Oku buzinda, Heroode arhenga eYudeeya ayandagalira omu gishagala ch'eKayizariya gurhanga kubeera yo.
Ogufa kwa mwami Heroode

Amo mango, haliiri obushombanyi ahagarhi ka Heroode n'abantu b'egishagala ch'eTiiro n'abe ch'eSidoona. Aliko, abo bantu bachihira haguma, baaja kumulola. Barhanga kuyunviikana na Balasito waliyimangiire enju ya mwami, baaja bahema omurhuula emwa mwami Heroode. Bulaala ebiryo bagendaga balya omu gihugo chaabo, byabaaga birhenga omu gihugo ch'oyo mwami.
Olusiku bayunvikanaga lwabeere lwahika, Heroode ayambala emyambalo y'echaami, ayikala oku ntebe yaage y'obwami ekarubanda, arhondera kuderha embere z'abantu.
N'abantu nabo baalema baderha ntya n'omulenge munene: «Gurhali mulenge g'omuntu ogu, sy'aliko guli gw'emaana!»
Ho n'aho, malahika wa Nnaweerhu ahaana Heroode, bulaala arhakuuzaga Nnamahanga, sy'achikuuza yenyine. Enzoka z'omu nda zamuluma bweneene, ava afa.
Aliko, eChinwa cha Nnamahanga chagendeerera kuja embere n'okuyandaala ahantu hanene.
Baranaaba na Saawulo babeere bamaamala akaasi kaabo eYerusaleema, bagaluka eAntiyokiya eyi bali haguma na Yohaana washembulwaga Mariko.

footnotes.text: 12.15 Omu nkengeero z'ekiyaahudi, ngasi muntu aligwerhe malahika waage w'okumulanga. Oyoola malahika aliiri ahulukira eyi agwerhe eshusho ly'oyoola muntu.
12.17 Oyuula Yakobo aliiri mwene waabo Yeesu. Osome Bagalatiya 1.19.
